recap.text: Carl stops listening to the recording of his father's trailer and goes to the master bedroom, taking everything he can with five minutes left. From the living room his father says something desperate and slurred, with nobody there to hear it. Carl takes three packs of Marlboro Reds and a folder of court documents, which he picks up without looking at it.

Across a table from Princess Chandra, Donut says Carl left legal papers from his father's trailer on the eighth floor lying in her room, too scared to look, she thinks, so she read them. Carl's grandparents set money aside for him, and his father was trying to get at it without Carl knowing. The pile also holds a marriage certificate for his father and his new wife, and court documents from his arrests.

beats.headline: Taken without looking
beats.text: With five minutes left in the recording of the trailer, Carl moves to the master bedroom, not wanting to eavesdrop any more, and takes everything he can. From the living room he hears his father say something, desperate and slurred, with nobody there to hear his final words. In the bedroom Carl takes three packs of Marlboro Reds, and then picks up a folder filled with court documents. He takes it without looking at it.
beats.gist: Carl takes three Marlboro Reds packs and an unread court folder while his father's last words go unheard.

beats.headline: Donut has read them
beats.text: Across a table from Princess Chandra and her stack of papers, Donut says Carl has some legal papers just like these, from his father's trailer on the eighth floor. He left them on the table in her room and is too scared to look, she thinks, but she read them. Carl's grandparents set money aside for Carl, and his father was trying to get at it without Carl knowing. There is a marriage certificate for his father and his new wife, and court documents from several arrests. Put together, Donut says, they paint a very distinct picture of who Carl's father was as a person.
beats.gist: Donut tells Chandra she read Carl's father's papers: a hidden trust, a marriage certificate, arrest records.
